contracts.tokens: Shared token reader strips quotes, retains quoted separators, treats comma/space/tab plus configurable separators as whitespace, and optionally emits single punctuation tokens. Empty quote pair terminates an empty token.
contracts.buffers: Writes token bytes and terminator using literal(capacity-1)&index, including non-power-of-two cases. Saves pre-read cursor to88ab4c. Text source current-character read is unmasked; end probes use line mask.
contracts.table: Signed stack depth>=7 returns-1 unchanged; otherwise increment depth, write primary table pointer, clear corresponding secondary pointer, and return current depth.
contracts.binary: Any nonzero parser+578 tail-calls explicit binary token reader without text/global mutation.
